alpha_and_framing.raw_low_alpha_note: Raw attempts kept verbatim, including any alpha1-8 noise. Unchanged helper uses alpha>8 visible bounding extraction before registration; final padding audit includes every nonzero registered alpha pixel.
alpha_and_framing.fragment_handling: Death/disintegration uses whole-pose cells and exact empty-gutter crops to preserve all drawn detached clusters. Strict optional components used only where complete separate row-major figures were unambiguous.

limits: This is worker artwork/registration/source-order/frame-review completion, not browser control, actual Godot loading, human animation acceptance or gameplay integration.
GIFs and SpriteFrames use10fps review timing; original timing is unknown, not accepted or changed in gameplay.

Low-resolution originals constrain reliable tooth/rib/minor bone detail; remastered microtexture and small anatomical detail are interpreted rather than pixel-identical. Source silhouette, camera, major limbs, wing posture and fragment clusters govern review.
Fine surface texture varies between newly generated frames. Offline contacts and decoded frame review do not establish real-time temporal smoothness.
No gameplay code, actor binding, AI, encounter, timing, canonical record, shared helper, Git or peer message was changed. Parent owns publication and independent acceptance.
